geometry_edits.rationale: Reduce twist intensity so the executable solid remains continuous across views and better supports calm upper hierarchy.
Increase the courtyard margin slightly to make the void more public and legible without breaking the protected hall ancestry.

graph_edits.rationale: Slightly reduce rotational stress so the mass reads as a calmer continuous block rather than a strongly pinched object.
Broaden the public void slightly to strengthen the occupiable courtyard figure and improve ground-level legibility.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing move: a compact twisted block with a carved internal court and a clear upper hierarchy. It responds well to the neighborhood-living brief because it does not resolve as a sealed box; instead it creates a meaningful void and a legible public interior. The main weakness is that the silhouette is slightly over-terraced and the section is not yet strongly programmatic, but this is not severe enough to fail the form. The blue frontage edge is answered by a ground-level opening/void relationship rather than a dead wall, so the access condition is satisfied. Across views the form remains consistent, with no obvious collisions or contradictory masses.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is a low-rise community/cultural pavilion; more open and sculptural than a compact neighborhood-living block.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part massing with a legible central void and bridge-like upper connection that preserves a clear public threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Aerial campus composition is broader and more distributed than this single compact mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-centered campus logic with stepped/terraced low-rise blocks and clear open-space hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Civic building precedent; the candidate is more compressed and less rectilinear.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A rectangular mass relieved by a large carved void and shallow overhangs to activate the ground edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference relies on a broader horizontal spread and more transparent perimeter than the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low elongated mass with a central courtyard and a sloping/folded roof language that keeps the form continuous.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Educational/campus organization is more fragmented than the candidate’s single-body courtyard block.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Multiple wings connected around a public core, with terraced links and an entry-oriented circulation figure.

warnings: The stepped/twisted upper edge is somewhat arbitrary and could be simplified into a calmer primary mass with one clearer gesture.
The section could better articulate an active ground threshold and a more explicit public-to-private gradient.
Preserve the dominant courtyard gesture; do not replace it with unrelated fragmentation.
